_comment: Brimholt item catalog, read by game/data/items.gd (rules) and tools/generators/make_sprites.py (icons and gear sheets).
Equipment: slot (necklace, helmet, cape, charm, main_hand, armor, legs, boots, off_hand, ring), level (a tier: 1, 5, 10 ... 45),
optional vocations, look (sprite shape; '+plume', '+crest', '+horns' decorate helmets), colors (main, light, accent).
Armor may name an outfit: a painted full-figure sheet (assets/sprites/outfits/<outfit>.png from art/outfits) drawn instead of the body, helmet, armor, legs, and boots layers.
Stats are derived from level and slot in game/data/items.gd; add an optional 'stats' object to override.

Relics (level 50, glow: halo colour, optional bonus over 1.15) drop only from final bosses (Monsters.LOOT). Other items: gold (purse value of a pile) or value (shop price of a monster material). Order sets the icon sheet.

Potions: price (vendor price), drink (stat -> share of the maximum restored), and cooldown (seconds before another potion of the same kind; each kind has its own timer). Packs: slot bag, bound, slots (extra backpack slots); town tasks award them.
Themed backpacks: slot container, look backpack+<style> (hand-pixelled in tools/generators/pixel_bags.py), loot_only rare drops instead of crafted.
Bags: slot container, slots (how many it holds), price; worn in the three bag slots, their slots extend the backpack. sold: vendors stock it; the others are crafted (Tailoring).

Professions (game/data/professions.gd): gathered resources (looks ore, log, herb, fish) have a value like materials. Crafted potions have no price (never vendor stock) and may share a timer with another potion. Food: eat {regen: extra share of health and mana regeneration, seconds}.
Vendor prices of equipment are derived in items.gd (gear_price); vendors buy unbound equipment for a quarter of it and materials for their value.

loot_only items are source-specific monster drops (hunting weapons, and the frost isles' notable armor), excluded from vendor stock and the generic tier pool. Their stats still derive from tier and vocation.

Swords: look sword+<style> or greatsword+<style> (copper, short, falchion, longsword, arming, curved, cleaver, serrated, estoc, fang, sanguine; rime, drakefang, tide, void, grand), each its own design, hand-pixelled in tools/generators/pixel_swords.py unless a painted icon exists. Focus leech: life leech by level (Items.leech_for, at most World.LEECH_MAX).

Monster drops: look trophy+<shape> (a claw, feather, eye, crown, shard...), hand-drawn in tools/generators/pixel_materials.py; gathered resources keep their looks ore, log, herb, fish and are drawn there too.

Showpiece axes: look hewer, amberaxe, venomaxe, seraphaxe, sanguineaxe or starsteelaxe (modelled in tools/generators/gear3d.py, held as the icon rebuilt into a weapon); a focus trades a tenth of the attack for a bonus (Items.WEAPON_FOCUS).

Showpiece boots: look wingboots, furboots, flameboots, frostboots, vialboots, scaleboots or bloomboots (modelled in tools/generators/gear3d.py). Gear-only stats (World.GEAR_STATS): speed (percent faster steps), mana_percent (percent more maximum mana), frost (percent more frost damage).
extra: stats added on top of the derived ones, e.g. {"frost": 9} for 9% more frost spell and rune damage (Combat.ELEMENT_STATS).

Showpiece helmets: look rootcrown, fangmask, dreadmask, hornhelm, crownhelm, lanternhelm, nimbus, visor or cobra (make_sprites.py helm_icon draws the icon; worn they take HELM_WORN's shape textured with it). A helmet's focus (health, mana, critical, healing, regen) costs some defense for that bonus (Items.HELMET_FOCUS). shine sheen: a light sweeps across the icon (assets/sprites/items_anim).

Rings: look ring+<style> (gem, signet, plasma, wreath, serpent, claw, skull, twin, crystal, star). An optional focus (health, mana, critical, healing, regen, defense) trades the tier ring's mixed stats for more of one (Items.RING_FOCUS); focused rings are loot_only drops (Monsters.LOOT).

Mounts: slot mount, stats {} (riding is the bonus: World.MOUNT_STEP), look (the mount's shape: steed, wolf, spider, lizard; '+antlers', '+tusks', '+tail' decorate it), colors (hide, light, mane or accent). Each boss drops its own at Monsters.MOUNT_CHANCE.

Mythic gear: unbound level-50 pieces without a glow, dropped only by the level-50 elite farm monsters (Monsters.LOOT); stats derive at level 50 with a 1.05 bonus (relics 1.15). An optional template names the painted icon tools/generators/derive_icons.py recolours.
